purpose: A new unsupervised native artist index and bounded human-genre-coherence retrieval diagnostic: does adding uploader instrument tags to a meaningful raw uploader-genre TF-IDF cosine baseline change observed human-genre coherence? Not listener relevance or source-truth artist membership.

pre_freeze_knowledge.inspected: Source identity, target availability, raw allowed-tag/gallery vocabulary/document-frequency counts only. Previous human-genre classification/calibration/caller-profile outcomes are known historical context.
pre_freeze_knowledge.selection: One candidate comparison, no searched feature mixtures, seeds, splits, dimensions, index settings or retrieval metrics. Original component folds reused unchanged, not selected for this task.

source.required_inputs: Only the exact metadata/human source bytes plus this protocol and checked serialization evidence; no previous model, predictions or evaluation payloads. Record truthful current input bindings without claiming a new acquisition.

identity: Replay full native metadata/human identity join before parsing targets. Build artist+album connected components over all11565 native metadata tracks, component minimum track ID, before target support filtering. Preserve713artists/components and2365albums; assert one native artist per component for these exact bytes. No name/fuzzy/alias joins; native identity isolation cannot prove different musicians or absence of duplicate audio.

folds.roles: Fold f query components versus all other four-fold gallery components. Every query component excluded completely; each of all713 artists receives exactly one query outcome per arm. No old NB/temperature vectors, supervised models or pairwise OOF mixtures.

features.allowed: Only literal uploader genre--- and instrument--- tags, native helper filtering. No human labels/taxonomies, moods, IDs, names, titles, path/duration, annotation availability or vote counts as index/ranking features.
features.artist_tf: Binary tag occurrence per metadata TRACK, summed across all of an artist native metadata tracks, divided by ALL those tracks including empty-tag tracks. No human-based track selection or album support filter.
features.gallery_vocabulary: Sorted gallery-only literal tags with artist document frequency >=1; never expand vocabulary from queries. Query-only unseen tags omitted from the gallery-defined coordinate system and reported explicitly.
features.document_frequency: For each gallery and tag, count distinct gallery artists with that tag present; N counts ALL gallery artists, including feature-empty artists.
features.idf: ln((1+N)/(1+DF))+1, one gallery-only IDF computation per original fold shared by both arms. No target-dependent fit, DF cutoff beyond >=1, tuning or query contribution.
features.baseline: genre-only TF*IDF then row L2 normalization.
features.candidate: Concatenate genre+instrument TF*IDF with every block weight1 then ONE global row L2 normalization; no separate block normalization or selected mixture.
features.numerics: Deterministic sorted native artist IDs and sorted literal vocabulary; dense NumPy float64 matrices. Normalize rows, then query_matrix @ gallery_matrix.T. Preserve raw finite computed cosine scores; allow up to1+1e-12 numerical tolerance, no post-outcome clipping, rounding or epsilon ties.
features.zero_rows: Preserve explicit empty_profile/no_eligible_positive_overlap outcomes; no fabricated zero-score neighbors or fallback rankings.

ranking.order: Exact raw finite cosine descending, then native component_id ascending, then native artist_id ascending. No rounding/epsilon tie policy.
ranking.all_artists: Keep all713 query outcomes per arm including unjudged, feature-empty and no-overlap artists, with reasons and <=10 full-gallery edges.
ranking.human_separation: Index builder and complete positive-cosine ordering consume NO human targets or annotation-availability mask. Evaluation alone condenses an already feature-ranked gallery by target availability for its judged-gallery metric; no target values alter order.

human_targets.taxonomy: Only genre_dortmund---; original strict amendment recognizes folk_country→folkcountry,funk_soul_rnb→funksoulrnb,rap_hiphop→raphiphop; no generic normalization. Empty payload is missing and not a taxonomy nomination.
human_targets.eligibility: Exactly3 recognized votes, including disagreements. Retain every metadata track and original reason; incomplete/invalid/unmatched/missing are not negatives.
human_targets.artist_target: Equal arithmetic mean of eligible TRACK fractional nine-class vote vectors. It is a sampled human-vote profile, not artist membership truth. Do not weight artists by number of annotated tracks in primary query average.
human_targets.primary: All368 artists with >=1 eligible track; no feature/retrieval-availability restriction.
human_targets.secondary: The predeclared204 query artists with >=2 eligible tracks, using the SAME gallery and index; do not select a different candidate pool. Preserve164 single-track and345 unjudged artists in coverage/support accounting.

evaluation_gate.requirements: Each of all5 galleries must have >=10 judged artists AND every one of all9 classes must have positive votes in >=5 distinct gallery artists. Count-only preflight supports all gates (minimum15).
evaluation_gate.failure: If any support gate fails, publish explicit no-evaluation census without numerical index/ranking/score execution; never drop a class/fold/query or reseed. Custody/identity/source mismatch aborts, not a support abstention.
evaluation_gate.query_coverage: All judged queries remain in metric denominators regardless of empty features, no overlap, zero IDCG or missing ranked slots.

metrics.gain: LINEAR fractional vote agreement g(q,c)=dot(y_q,y_c), no exponential gain; absent annotation is unjudged, never gain0.
metrics.primary: Mean over all368 judged query components of condensed judged-gallery NDCG@10, candidate minus baseline. Positive-cosine ordered gallery is filtered for judged candidates only at evaluation. Missing rank slots contribute0 DCG.
metrics.ideal: IDCG sorts gains over ALL judged gallery artists, independent of feature support/overlap; top10 linear discounted gains.
metrics.undefined_cases: IDCG0 yields NDCG0 plus explicit reason/count, retaining denominator. No judged gallery yields0 plus explicit reason/count. Do not exclude these queries.
auxiliary: Condensed judged mean vote agreement@10=sum returned judged gains/10, fixed denominator10; report per-query IDCG and positive-gain judged-gallery count.

Full-gallery top10 judged/unjudged/missing slot counts and judgment coverage, separate from relevance. Conditional mean observed gain over returned judged neighbors only; null if none. Never compute full-gallery NDCG or fill unjudged with negative/zero gain.

Exact uniform-random expected condensed DCG=mean gain over ALL judged gallery artists*sum(d_1..d_10); divide by SAME IDCG under same zero rules. Expected random mean agreement@10 equals mean judged-gallery gain. No sampled random rankings.
metrics.diagnostics: Report all5 fold results, overall artist-equal means, all9 source-class-weighted query diagnostics (weight each judged query by its artist vote mass in that class, normalize within class; null only if no class mass), and instrument-present/absent query strata (any instrument tag anywhere in all native metadata tracks). Include all denominators/supports; do not select a winning fold/class/stratum.

bootstrap.unit: Paired query COMPONENT resampling with replacement; fixed galleries, indices, rankings and targets. Overall judged368 and robust204 query sets use distinct fixed seeds. No refitting or reselection inside draws.
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive reused-cohort fixed-gallery intervals, not independent-population or retraining estimates.

architecture: Separate source/identity/availability census and externally pinned numeric run/replay. Freeze census before any IDF/vector/ranking/metric computation. Reuse unchanged native identity/canonicalization helpers, forbid all supervised fit/train/partial_fit calls. Keep rank/index interface feature-only; evaluator reads targets separately. Fresh atomic publication, closed regular-file inventories, exact physical hashes/sizes, external protocol/census/result pins, targeted implementation and numerical runtime pins.

accounting.note: IDF is gallery-derived unsupervised index fitting, not zero total fitting. Replay repeats the frozen five-index computation without searching alternatives.

rights.attribution: Music Technology Group; Bogdanov, Won, Tovstogan, Porter and Serra (2019), The MTG-Jamendo Dataset for Automatic Music Tagging; Music Classification Annotations documentation
rights.commit_policy: Only code, protocol and restrained attributed aggregates committed. Native profiles, ranks, target ledger, source and index artifacts remain local noncommercial research data. No UI/default/serving/deployment integration.

interpretation: Observed coarse nine-class human-genre coherence of native artist profiles, not listener relevance, recommendation usefulness, artist membership truth or EveryNoise parity. Historical cohort and labels already inspected; no untouched confirmation. Annotation blinding/independence, sparse/selected human annotation coverage and audio duplicates across native identities are not established. This single raw-genre versus added-instrument comparison does not repair unavailable independent data or validate prior NB/T models.

source_alternative_assessment.provenance: Parent independent read-only source feasibility checks; not a new acquisition by this slice.
source_alternative_assessment.retained_limits: Old native AB cohort gives11 own-fold out-of-fit emissions; larger compatible AB/FMA numeric sources remain blocked/unreadable and denied routes are not retried. Retained Jamendo offers only the declared human-class proxy, not pairwise listening/recommendation judgments.
source_alternative_assessment.CityMTag: Official documentation exposes direct human triplet data, but no explicit license/permission grant was found; do not acquire or use it without appropriate permission.
source_alternative_assessment.LFM-1b: https://www.cp.jku.at/datasets/LFM-1b/ explicitly states withdrawal for licensing reasons; do not acquire/use withdrawn data.
source_alternative_assessment.ocelma: 1k/360k documentation pages timed out; no data acquired and no licensing/access inference beyond those observed attempts.
source_alternative_assessment.boundary: These are source-specific independent checks, not a claim that every possible free source is unavailable. No alternate/denied-source retry or acquisition is authorized.
